canonical_title: Bulgarian Government Scholarships for Foreign Citizens (Intergovernmental Agreements)

programme_type.value: Government scholarships under bilateral intergovernmental agreements (Decrees 103/1993 and 228/1997)

funding_coverage.value: Full tuition coverage, monthly stipend for 12 months, health insurance

eligibility_nationality.value: Foreign citizens of Bulgarian origin living abroad; citizens of North Macedonia; nominated by home country Ministry of Education

application_process.value: Nomination by home country Ministry of Education; application through Ministry of Education and Science of Bulgaria online platform

deadline.value: Annual cycle; 2026/2027 rules published March 2026; contact Ministry for exact dates

notes: Programme operates through bilateral agreements; not a direct-apply scheme. Candidates must be nominated by their home country's Ministry of Education. Official rules for 2026/2027 published March 2026.
provider: Ministry of Education and Science of the Republic of Bulgaria

programme_type.value: Croatian Government Bilateral Scholarships for 2026/2027 academic year

application_pools.value: Pool 1: Bilateral Agreements (8 types); Pool 2: Croatian Language Learning (2 types)

scholarship_types.value: A1: Croatian language 4-5 months; A2: Partial BA/MA 4-10 months; B: Full BA/MA degree; C1/C2: PhD full/partial; D: Postdoctoral 1-10 months; Pool 2: Language semester/summer seminar

funding_coverage.value: Tuition-free studies, monthly financial support (300 EUR for students, 320 EUR for PhD), subsidized accommodation and meals

eligible_countries.value: Belgium (Flanders), Bulgaria, China, Czech Republic, Germany (Bavaria), Greece, Hungary, Israel, Italy, Kosovo, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Turkey, Ukraine

degree_levels.value: Bachelor's, Master's, PhD, Postdoctoral, Language courses

notes: Applications via Agency for Mobility and EU Programmes online system. Requires nomination by foreign partner institution (Pool 1) or Croatian language professor recommendation (Pool 2). 2026/2027 call closed April 2026; watch for 2027/2028 announcement.
provider: Ministry of Science, Education and Youth / Agency for Mobility and EU Programmes

programme_types.value: Three streams: 1) Summer schools (Apr 1-May 1); 2) Researchers/academic staff grants (Apr 1-May 1); 3) Degree/exchange studies (Oct 1-Oct 31)

funding_coverage.value: Monthly stipend only; BA/MA: 350 EUR/month; PhD: 660 EUR/month; no tuition coverage

eligible_countries.value: Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Croatia, Czech Republic, Cyprus, Egypt, Finland, France, Georgia, Germany, UK, Greece, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Israel, Italy, Kazakhstan, Latvia, Lithuania, Mexico, Moldova, China, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, South Korea, Slovenia, Spain, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Tunisia, Turkey, Ukraine, USA

degree_levels.value: BA (only Estonian language/culture fields), MA (all fields), PhD (all fields)

application_deadlines.value: Summer schools/Researchers: 1 Apr - 1 May 2026; Degree/exchange: 1 Oct - 31 Oct 2026

notes: Administered by Education and Youth Board (Harno). Highly competitive (~10% success rate). 15 scholarships for 2026 round. Requires confirmation of admission to Estonian HEI by deadline. Applications via email to rvo.dokumendid@harno.ee.
provider: Education and Youth Board (Harno) / Ministry of Education and Research

programme_types.value: Study scholarships (BA/MA/PhD) and Summer school scholarships

funding_coverage.value: Monthly stipend only; BA/MA: 500 EUR/month (up to 10 months); PhD: 700 EUR/month (up to 11 months); no tuition coverage

eligible_countries.value: 39 countries with bilateral agreements: Azerbaijan, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Egypt, Finland, France, Georgia, Israel, Italy, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Lithuania, Mexico, Moldova, Mongolia, Peru, Poland, South Korea, Spain, Tajikistan, China, Turkey, Turkmenistan, Ukraine, Uzbekistan, Vietnam, plus Austria, Czech Republic, Estonia, Germany, Hungary, Iceland, Indonesia, Japan, Slovakia, Switzerland, USA

application_process.value: Online via VIAA system (scholarships.viaa.gov.lv); requires confirmation letter from Latvian HEI

notes: Administered by State Education Development Agency (VIAA). 2026/2027 call closed April 2026. Watch for 2027/2028 announcement in early 2027.
provider: State Education Development Agency (VIAA) / Ministry of Education and Science

programme_types.value: Full-time Master's/Integrated studies; Short-term studies (1 semester, max 6 months); Lithuanian language and culture courses

funding_coverage.value: Monthly stipend + tuition grant; Master's: 592 EUR/month + tuition up to national standard; Short-term BA/MA: 592 EUR/month; Short-term PhD: 1184 EUR/month

eligible_countries.value: Master's: Armenia, Azerbaijan, China, Georgia, Indonesia, Israel, Japan, Kazakhstan, Moldova, New Zealand, Philippines, South Korea, Ukraine, USA, Uzbekistan, Vietnam, Lithuanian origin non-EU/EFTA; Short-term: adds Australia, Canada, India, UK

application_deadlines.value: Full-time Master's: 20 April 2026 (16:00 Vilnius); Short-term: 17 April 2026 (16:00 Vilnius); Language course: 22 Oct 2026

notes: Administered by Education Exchanges Support Foundation. 70 Master's grants (20 for Ukraine, 5 for Lithuanian origin). Requires admission confirmation from Lithuanian HEI. Applications via SMPF online system.
provider: Education Exchanges Support Foundation / Ministry of Education, Science and Sport

programme_type.value: Annual Romanian Government scholarship programme for non-EU citizens via Ministry of Foreign Affairs

funding_coverage.value: Tuition fee exemption, Romanian language preparatory year, monthly scholarship, accommodation in student dormitories (subject to availability)

eligible_nationalities.value: All non-EU countries (exceptions: Romanian origin/historical communities, protection seekers, diplomats, international org staff, current Romanian scholarship holders)

degree_levels.value: Bachelor's (3-6 years), Master's (1-2 years), PhD (4 years)

language_requirements.value: BA/MA: Romanian language only (preparatory year provided); PhD: English or foreign language set by doctoral school

notes: Online application via scholarships.studyinromania.gov.ro. Excludes Medicine, Dental Medicine, Pharmacy. Apostilled documents required. 2026/2027 cycle closed March 2026; watch for 2027/2028 announcement in Feb 2027.
provider: Ministry of Foreign Affairs / Ministry of Education and Research

programme_type.value: Long-term development cooperation scholarships for full degree studies at public universities in Slovakia

funding_coverage.value: BA/MA: 700 EUR/month + 100 EUR start + 200 EUR completion + 80 EUR/month university stipend; PhD: 1100 EUR/month + 100/200 EUR + 240 EUR/month university stipend; Language prep: 700 EUR/month + 100 EUR + 80 EUR/month

eligible_countries.value: ODA-eligible countries: Afghanistan, Albania, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bosnia, Cuba, Ethiopia, Georgia, India, Indonesia, Iraq, Jordan, Kazakhstan, Kenya, Kosovo, Kyrgyzstan, Lebanon, Moldova, Mongolia, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Palestine, Serbia, Sudan, Syria, Tajikistan, Tanzania, Tunisia, Ukraine, Uzbekistan, Vietnam; plus Slovaks Living Abroad

age_limits.value: BA/MA: 18-26 years by 1 Sep; PhD: 23-35 years by 1 Sep

notes: Applications via www.vladnestipendia.sk. Requires nomination by compatriot organization or Slovak embassy. Slovak language proficiency required. 2026/2027 cycle open until May 25, 2026.
provider: Ministry of Education, Research, Development and Youth

programme_type.value: Short-term mobility scholarships (1-10 months) for study/research/teaching/artistic stays

funding_coverage.value: Monthly stipend for living costs; travel allowance available separately

eligible_applicants.value: MA students (completed 2.5+ years), PhD students, university teachers/researchers/artists; must be accepted by Slovak HEI/research org

application_deadlines.value: 30 April 2026 (16:00 CET) for full year/winter; 31 Oct 2026 (16:00 CET) for summer semester

notes: Administered by SAIA. Online application at www.scholarships.sk. Does not support full degree studies. Cannot combine with Erasmus+, CEEPUS, bilateral agreements, etc. 2026/2027 deadlines published.
provider: Ministry of Education, Research, Development and Youth / SAIA

programme_type.value: Bilateral scholarships based on government-to-government agreements for study/research stays (1-10 months)

eligible_countries.value: Belgium (French/Walloon), Bulgaria, China, Croatia, Czech Republic, Egypt, Finland, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Italy, Kazakhstan, North Macedonia, Moldova, Montenegro, Norway, Poland, Romania, Slovenia, Serbia, Switzerland, Turkey, Ukraine

scholarship_coverage.value: Monthly stipend; free accommodation in student dormitory; tuition not covered; cannot be used for full degree

monthly_amounts.value: 620 EUR (BA/MA students), 1025.50 EUR (PhD), 1025.50 EUR (teachers w/o PhD), 1420 EUR (teachers with PhD)

nomination_deadline.value: 1 April 2026 (by competent authorities of eligible countries)

notes: Nominations by home country education ministries/agencies. Individual applications not accepted. Requires Letter of Acceptance from Slovak HEI. 2026/2027 nomination deadline April 1, 2026.
provider: Ministry of Education, Research, Development and Youth

canonical_title: Slovenia Ad Futura Scholarships for Western Balkans 2026/2027

programme_type.value: Ad Futura scholarships for Western Balkans citizens for Master's studies in Slovenia (380th public call)

funding_coverage.value: 9,600 EUR/year (800 EUR/month) for living expenses for official duration of programme

eligible_countries.value: Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Kosovo, North Macedonia, Serbia

eligible_fields.value: Natural Sciences, Mathematics/Statistics, ICT, Engineering/Manufacturing, Civil Engineering, Agriculture/Forestry/Fisheries, Veterinary Medicine, Health/Social Security

degree_level.value: Master's (2nd cycle) only; not for unified Master's

total_budget.value: 300,000 EUR total for all scholarship years

notes: Administered by Public Scholarship, Development, Disability and Maintenance Fund (Javna skladnica). Requires temporary residence in Slovenia or power of attorney by deadline. Must reside in Slovenia from 1 Oct 2026. Apply to Dunajska 20, 1000 Ljubljana.
provider: Public Scholarship, Development, Disability and Maintenance Fund of the Republic of Slovenia

programme_type.value: Bilateral scholarships based on government agreements for short-term study/research stays (3-10 months)

eligible_countries.value: Bulgaria (14), Bosnia and Herzegovina (18), Hungary (12), India (24), Italy (20), Japan (12), Kosovo (18), Mexico (24), Montenegro (18), Poland (46), China (72), North Macedonia (36), Serbia (18), Slovakia (20), Switzerland (12), Turkey (9)

scholarship_months.value: Total months per country as listed; typically 3-10 months per stay

coverage.value: 400 EUR/month; free accommodation (student dorm 2B rooms); subsidized meals; basic medical insurance for non-EU

notes: Administered by CMEPIUS. Nominations by home country ministries. Not for full degree studies. Cannot combine with Erasmus+/CEEPUS. Requires Letter of Acceptance from Slovenian HEI.
provider: Ministry of Higher Education, Science and Innovation / CMEPIUS

canonical_title: Malta Endeavour II Scholarships Scheme 2026 (5th Call)

programme_type.value: Endeavour II Scholarships Scheme (5th Call 2026) - co-funded by ESF+

funding_coverage.value: Fully funded: tuition fees + allowances + study-related expenses

eligible_nationalities.value: All nationalities (residency conditions apply; permanent residence permit mandatory for foreign nationals)

notes: Administered by Ministry for Education, Sport, Youth, Research and Innovation (MEYR). Requires E-ID. Applications via myscholarship-apply.gov.mt. 2026 call closed June 2026; watch for future calls.
provider: Ministry for Education, Sport, Youth, Research and Innovation

programme_type.value: Tertiary Education Scholarships Scheme (TESS) for MQF Level 7 and 8

application_window.value: 27 April - 5 June 2026 (noon); follow-up docs deadline 9 Oct 2026

eligibility.value: Maltese citizens meeting residence conditions; EU/EEA nationals with specified residence/worker status; third-country nationals with 5 years residence and long-term status; UK Withdrawal Agreement holders

notes: 2026 window closed. Eligibility tied to Malta connections, not just admission. No confirmation of 2027 call yet published.
provider: Ministry for Education, Sport, Youth, Research and Innovation

canonical_title: Luxembourg Guillaume Dupaix International Excellence Scholarship 2026/2027

programme_types.value: Three streams: Master's Excellence (2 years), Exchange (1-2 semesters), PhD visits (1+ month)

funding_coverage.value: Master's: 11,526 EUR/year (5,763 EUR/semester) for living/accommodation; Exchange: ~5,763 EUR/semester; PhD: ~1,150 EUR/month + 1,500 EUR travel grant; NO tuition coverage

eligible_nationalities.value: Master's: 15 regular (any nationality) + 15 target countries (Western Balkans, Ibero-America, Thailand, Vietnam, Belarus, Egypt, India, Moldova, Russia, UK, Turkey, Ukraine); Exchange: partner university countries; PhD: Canada, China, USA, South Korea, Japan, Australia, Morocco, South Africa, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, Uruguay, Thailand, Singapore, Vietnam, UK

degree_levels.value: Master's, Bachelor's/Master's exchange, PhD research visits

application_deadline.value: Master's: 24 March 2026 (missing docs 31 March); Exchange: 15 May (winter) / 1 Nov (summer); PhD: 31 Dec 2026

number_of_awards.value: 30 Master's per year (15 regular + 15 target); Exchange: ~5 per faculty; PhD: varies

notes: Funded by Ministry of Research and Higher Education (regular) and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (target countries). 2026/2027 Master's intake closed March 2026. Exchange/PhD deadlines later in 2026. Watch for 2027/2028 Master's call ~March 2027.
provider: University of Luxembourg / Ministry of Research and Higher Education / Ministry of Foreign Affairs

canonical_title: Icelandic Government Scholarships 2026/2027 (BA Icelandic as Second Language)

programme_type.value: Icelandic Government Scholarships for BA in Icelandic as a Second Language at University of Iceland

funding_coverage.value: Registration fees at University of Iceland + monthly stipend for room/board (Sep-Apr); accommodation in Gamli Garður dormitory available

eligible_countries.value: Austria, Bulgaria, Canada, China, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Faroe Islands, Finland, France, Germany, Netherlands, Hungary, Italy, Japan, Latvia, Lithuania, Norway, Poland, Russia, Slovakia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, UK, USA

degree_level.value: BA in Icelandic as a Second Language (180 ECTS, 3 years)

language_requirements.value: Minimum A2+ Icelandic (CEFR); pass admission test in June; English proficiency required; exemption if completed Practical Diploma with 7.25+

application_deadline.value: 1 December annually (postmark deadline); US citizens via Fulbright with different deadline

duration.value: Up to 3 academic years (renewable annually with reapplication by Dec 1)

notes: Administered by Árni Magnússon Institute for Icelandic Studies. Paper applications only (no email). Apply to Edda, Arngrímsgata 5, 107 Reykjavík. US citizens apply via Fulbright. 2026/2027 deadline Dec 1, 2026.
provider: Ministry of Culture, Innovation and Higher Education / Árni Magnússon Institute

canonical_title: Cyprus CyprusAid Scholarships 2026/2027 (CUT, AUB Mediterraneo, University of Nicosia)

programme_types.value: CyprusAid scholarships via Ministry of Foreign Affairs partnerships with universities

funding_coverage.value: Full tuition, university dormitory accommodation, 400 EUR/month stipend, laptop up to 500 EUR, airfare up to 1000 EUR, visa/permit fees, medical exams, insurance up to 180 EUR

eligible_countries.value: CUT: São Tomé and Príncipe, Armenia, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan, Lesotho, Eswatini, Liberia, Timor-Leste, Philippines, Indonesia, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, South Africa, Ghana, Egypt, Lebanon, Palestine, Jordan, Bahrain, Ethiopia, Madagascar, Mauritius, Seychelles, Comoros, Papua New Guinea, Fiji, Kiribati, Marshall Islands, Nauru, Samoa, Solomon Islands, Tonga, Tuvalu, Vanuatu; AUB Mediterraneo: similar; UNIC: Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Zambia, Botswana, Mauritius, Ghana, Senegal, Tanzania, Madagascar

degree_levels.value: Undergraduate, Postgraduate (Master's), PhD (all PhD programmes at CUT)

partner_universities.value: Cyprus University of Technology (CUT), American University of Beirut - Mediterraneo, University of Nicosia

application_deadlines.value: CUT: 12 June 2026; AUB Mediterraneo: 6 July 2026; UNIC Spring 2027: 6 Nov 2026

notes: No national scholarship foundation for international students; CyprusAid is the only full-degree funding route. 2026/2027 rounds closed June-July 2026. Watch university pages for 2027/2028. Also College of Europe scholarship via MFA (29,000 EUR).
provider: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (CyprusAid) / Partner Universities
